run_download_support_docs: run the ELI5 script to download CommonCrawl support documents for subreddit posts
create_docs_directory: create a docs directory with 10 subdirectories for organizing downloaded articles by slice
select_specific_ccids: build a selection map from a list of CommonCrawl UUIDs for targeted document retrieval
select_specific_urls: build a selection map from a list of URLs for targeted document retrieval
check_url_in_selection: check if a given URL exists in the prebuilt URL selection map
